name: SolarMente
long_description:
SolarMente helps homeowners in Southern Europe install solar, storage, and heat pumps with zero upfront cost, allowing them to pay through predictable monthly savings. 
Based in Barcelona, we’ve raised $5M from YC, Climate Capital, Soma Capital, Plug & Play, Leonardo DiCaprio, and others.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: HEC Mtl (Financial Engineering), Stanford (CS & Entrepreneurship); Front Row Ventures (focus on space/satellites); intern at Microsoft (Windows 10 launch); ConsenSys grant recipient (built Ethereum-based P2P solar energy app). Co-founder @SolarMente: built and led Finance, Ops, and Tech from 0 to $10M ARR, raised $5M equity + $50M debt

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Co-founder of SolarMente. Founder of BrutusBoot.
Expansion @ Nerdalize, YES!Delft.

I also like old motorcycles.
